replacements.after: await js('window.__cadTest.workbenchUI.setMode('+JSON.stringify(mode)+');void 0');if(mode==='solid'||mode==='fusion'){await click('[data-'+mode+'-menu="extras"] > summary');await js("(()=>{const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-"+mode+"-menu=extras] button')].filter(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Projektfotos');if(buttons.length!==1)throw Error('Project photo menu entry is not unique');buttons[0].id='perspective-project-photos-route';})()");await click('#perspective-project-photos-route');}else await click('#photo-project-open');

async function click(selector){if(selector==="#photo-project-open"){const mode=await js('window.__cadTest.workbenchUI.mode()');if(['solid','fusion'].includes(mode)){const menu='[data-'+mode+'-menu=extras]';await click(menu+' > summary');const index=await js("Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("+JSON.stringify(menu+' button')+")).findIndex(e=>e.textContent.trim()==="+JSON.stringify("Projektfotos")+")");assert(index>=0,'Visible Projektfotos menu entry exists in '+mode);return click(menu+' button:nth-child('+(index+1)+')');}}
